messages.subject: Try to place order but system tells me cart is empty
messages.text:
Hello

I tried adding some items to cart but when I want to check out, I see my cart is empty- have I done something wrong?

Regards

Antonietta 

Sent from my iPhone

messages.subject: Re: Try to place order but system tells me cart is empty
messages.text:
Hi Antoinetta,
 

 First of all, please accept our sincere apologies for the delay in responding.
 

 We’re sorry you experienced an issue with your cart. It’s possible that the items were not successfully added, or that the session expired before checkout was completed.
 

 Since we weren’t able to assist you at the time, we just wanted to follow up — were you able to complete your order in the meantime? If not, is everything working properly now, or would you like assistance placing your order?
 

 We’d be more than happy to help make the process easier for you.
 

 Looking forward to your reply,
 

 Lasclay
